method: Shortest surface-copper centerline/land-anchor path to first same-net via, after copper zones removed in memory. Same-net copper touching and crossings are joined. Results are geometric mounting-path screening, not RF current distribution or total loop inductance. Center-of-land length includes pad metal. Via-to-plane vertical distances and plane spreading are not included.
